name: Nasir Uddin
headline: Frontend-Focused Full Stack Engineer
summary: Frontend-focused Full Stack Engineer with expertise in modern JavaScript and TypeScript ecosystems. I architect and deliver complex web applications that bridge exceptional user experience with robust engineering principles — from real-time enterprise HRMS platforms to cross-platform mobile apps. Currently building scalable systems at Flyhub, where I lead frontend architecture and contribute across the full stack with Node.js, MongoDB, and REST APIs.
about:
I am a Full Stack Engineer who believes great software is defined by the experience it creates. My primary domain is the frontend — React, TypeScript, and modern frameworks — but I am equally fluent across the entire stack, from REST API design with Express and NestJS to database modeling with MongoDB and PostgreSQL.

I have built production systems across diverse domains: travel tech B2B platforms, HRMS tools, employee engagement apps, and cross-platform mobile applications with Flutter. Every project is an opportunity to raise the bar on performance, accessibility, and engineering discipline.

Beyond code, I care deeply about developer experience, clean architecture, and the kind of systematic thinking that makes systems easy to reason about and modify months after they were built.
